about: The site's delivery in a real browser (tools/ci/site-browser.sh, tools/ci/site-perf.mjs): the built page served as Pages serves it (gzip), a cold visit over a 20 Mbit/s, 40 ms connection at 1280×800, then to the features and back. Bytes, milliseconds.

budgets.why: 3.56 MB (2026-11-08): the wasm 2.67 compressed, the Latin fonts; another language's face (the Chinese, 1.45 MB) only when the page needs it — it was fetched after every first frame (5.01 MB, red list 24). Held at 4 MB so it stays won

1.82 MB on the way to the first frame (2026-11-09, D5): the program split by what its first screen runs (tools/ci/site-split.sh) — its first half 1.29 MB compressed of 2.72 — and the Latin fonts; the second half compiled after the first frame. 3.3 MB before the split
D5: the first screen visible within a second — the static page the browser paints before the program (0.10 s locally, 2026-11-08)
D5: the program's first frame with the program split — 1.24 s locally, 1.55 s on CI (2026-11-09; 1.94 s on CI before the split, 4.5 s before the static first screen); held at 2.2 s so it stays won
D5: window.omui answers (an agent can act) — 1.19 s locally, 1.43 s on CI with the program split (2026-11-09; 1.85 s on CI before); held at 2.1 s
16.7 ms locally; a slower runner's headroom
